        if grid[r][c]==0 or (r,c) in seen: continue
        color=grid[r][c]; stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); comp=[]
        while stack:
          y,x=stack.pop(); comp.append((y,x))
          for yy,xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
            if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx]!=0:
              seen.add((yy,xx)); stack.append((yy,xx))
        comps.append(comp)
    # Palette is the connected, solid rectangular color swatch; the other component is the motif.
    pal=max(comps,key=lambda q: len(q))
    pr0,pr1=min(r for r,c in pal),max(r for r,c in pal); pc0,pc1=min(c for r,c in pal),max(c for r,c in pal)
    if len(pal)!=(pr1-pr0+1)*(pc1-pc0+1):

    motif=max((q for q in comps if q is not pal),key=len)

    shape={(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in pts}
    # The color key is the nonzero rectangular swatch in the lower area.
    keyrows=[r for r in range(h) if any(grid[r][c] not in (0,1) for c in range(w))]
    kr=keyrows[0]
    nz=[c for c in range(w) if grid[kr][c] not in (0,1)]
    colors=grid[kr][min(nz):max(nz)+1]
    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    sh=r1-r0+1; sw=c1-c0+1
    top=r0-((len(colors)-1)//2)*sh
    for i,col in enumerate(colors):
        for dr,dc in shape:
            rr=top+i*sh+dr; cc=c0+dc
            if 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w: out[rr][cc]=col
    return out
